privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title is 'Participatory Budgeting 2026'. The question 'Project Preference' appears in the UI as 'Which project is your top priority?' (ID: PROJ). The 'Priority Score' question appears as 'Assign a priority score (1-10) for your choice.' (ID: SCORE). The 'Zip Code' question appears as 'What is your Zip Code?' (ID: ZIP). The 'Household Income' question appears as 'What is your annual household income?' (ID: INCOME). Public statistics settings are typically found under 'Survey settings' -> 'Presentation' and individual question visibility is managed under 'Question settings' -> 'Statistics'.
